verdict.rationale: A state corporation filing system could plausibly offer an API or automation interface for headless or CI use, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: blanket crawl disallows on the SCC and Clerk's Information System hosts, plus a separate Virginia Tax host that bans GPTBot by name. None of this documents any headless, scripted or CI-runnable capability, so there is no evidence the product delivers the story.
